'''Fashk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Flesh Raider]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. As a descendant of mutated lower-caste [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], he was the first and only known Rakatan-related being that was able to touch [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] since the Rakata lost that ability due to a plague in [[25,200 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="Codex: Rakata">{{TORcite|type=codex|Rakata}}</ref>

==Biography==
{{GameLS}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Flesh Raider]], Fashk lived on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] where he resided in the [[Tythos Ridge]] during the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] resettling of the planet during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During a raid on the [[Pilgrims]]' [[Kalikori village]], Fashk abducted a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] boy named [[Viyo Kobbeth]] to use as an interpreter. When a traveling [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] from the nearby [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] came looking for Kobbeth, Fashk abandoned the Flesh Raiders and revealed his desires to join the Order instead since he wanted to control his Force abilities through [[Jedi training/Legends|training]]. Fashk wished to become a better hunter through fine control of the Force, and the Padawan believed it would be best if the Flesh Raider could at least be evaluated by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] at the Temple. The Padawan also knew that if Fashk was left to his own devices, there was always a chance he could fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="TOR" /> The Padawan then met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Strayen]] to discuss the issue, in which they agreed on the matter that he had to be trained. When the Padawan delivered the news along with a token to ensure Fashk's safe entry into the temple, the Flesh Raider released Viyo to the Padawan and immediately headed for the Temple.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Fashk is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />

Fashk can be encountered by either the future [[Hero of Tython]] or the future [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] as a side quest. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] choice involves [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|Force Pushing]] him off the cliff into a fire pit.<ref name="TOR" />
